headline: Brown Brings Star Power, but Evan Wins the Two-for-One Math
verdict: Evan is the current winner on overall grade and value, though both teams receive a strong roster-fit boost.
summary: Payton turns two wideouts into one premium target, swapping DK Metcalf and George Pickens for A.J. Brown. The move carries a B- grade, but the 91 roster-fit score and 88 lineup-impact score show why Brown makes sense for a 5-9 Big Pitts and Bass team. Brown’s 20.4 recent average is the splashiest supplied production figure in the deal, while Payton also keeps a strong core featuring Jahmyr Gibbs, Puka Nacua, and Bucky Irving. Evan’s packageValue is higher at 116, earning the Reigning Champ a B and the edge in overall score, value, and lineup impact. That is a sturdy haul for a reigning champion, even if Brown is the single biggest name moved.
